title: Happy Place
author: Emily Henry
summary: Harriet and Wyn broke up months ago but haven't told their friends. At their annual week at a Maine cottage, they pretend to still be together so as not to ruin the trip.
readIf: you like a friend-group romance that balances laughter with a real ache.
skipIf: you dislike secrets kept from friends or want a lighter, simpler plot.

pairings.reason: Another Emily Henry story with a hurting heroine, banter and an emotional centre.
A lighter, sillier pretend-couple romance with a trip.
A more sombre book about two people who love each other and can't communicate.
